jijimon-errand.t1: Thanks again for the meat. It was delicious!
jijimon-errand.t2: I've been so hungry lately, and my pantry is empty.
jijimon-errand.t3: Could you bring me two Meat? I'll pay you well.
jijimon-errand.t5: Perfect! I'll wait for you here.
jijimon-errand.t7: Oh well... if you change your mind, you know where I am.
jijimon-errand.t8: You brought the meat! Here, you've earned it.
jijimon-errand.t9: I still need two Meat. Don't take too long!
